art_review.reviewer: Codex artwork inspection; no user approval
observations: The teal core, cream eye, copper vanes and violet tail remain recognizable across all six frames.
The tail jumps between left and right silhouettes; the high pose to following pose and the loop need timing review.
Core facet patterns and the eye placement change across poses. Vane and tail visible areas need redraw or justified occlusion review.
The exported 64-cell art is a fixed projection of a nongrid raw image. Uniform output cells do not prove raw pixel quality.

issues.detail: Lowest visible row varies across the sequence: [46, 49, 53, 54]. Intentional for jumps or bobbing; otherwise the sprite may jitter.

limitations: Named part masks and features are supplied observations, not automatic semantic recognition.
Part area, rotation-only shape/pattern and color checks do not prove identity or natural movement.
Foreshortening, occlusion, flexible parts and pose-dependent shading require a recorded visual review.
Projection is a declared derivative; a compliant exported PNG does not certify the raw generator's pixel grid.
